o: Write simple SQL queries to retrieve records.
Use the technique in a different problem.
Explain the OCR ERL example and test a modification.
c: SELECT names the fields to retrieve. SELECT Name returns pupil names, not all columns.
FROM identifies the table, for example FROM Pupils. Read the given table and field names carefully.
WHERE selects only the rows that satisfy its condition, for example WHERE Year = 10. A pupil in Year 11 does not match.
For Pupils rows (101,Ada,10), (102,Ben,11), (103,Mia,10), SELECT Name FROM Pupils WHERE Year = 10 returns Ada and Mia. Writing SQL as text in OCR ERL does not execute it against a database.

m.title: Worked SQL query · pupil table
m.q: Pupils table (ID, Name, Year) contains (101,Ada,10), (102,Ben,11), (103,Mia,10). Write SQL to retrieve names of Year 10 pupils and give the result. [4 marks]
st: SELECT Name requests the Name field. [1]
FROM Pupils selects the correct table. [1]
WHERE Year = 10 excludes Ben's Year 11 record. [1]
Full query: SELECT Name FROM Pupils WHERE Year = 10; returned names are Ada and Mia. [1]

SELECT Title [1] FROM Books [1]. A WHERE condition is unnecessary.

SELECT Name FROM Teams [1] WHERE House = 'Red' [1].
Members has fields Name and Paid, with rows (Ada,Yes), (Ben,No), (Mia,Yes). Write SQL to return names with Paid = 'Yes'; state the results. [4 marks]
SELECT Name [1] FROM Members [1] WHERE Paid = 'Yes' [1]; Ada and Mia are returned [1].

k.q: The OCR ERL program PRINTS a SQL query as text; it does not run that query against a database. Predict and improve the statement.
k.code:
query = "SELECT Name FROM Pupils WHERE Year = 10"
print(query)
p: Predict exactly which SQL text the program prints.
Change Year = 10 to Year = 11; predict the new printed text.
Write the separate SQL statement SELECT Title FROM Books WHERE Genre = 'Science'; explain what a database would return.
k.a: Original printed string: SELECT Name FROM Pupils WHERE Year = 10. Changed string: SELECT Name FROM Pupils WHERE Year = 11. A valid new SQL statement is SELECT Title FROM Books WHERE Genre = 'Science'. A database engine would return matching Title values; this OCR ERL program only prints the text.
